name: Nevrolens
summary:
# About the app
Nevrolens is an augmented reality application designed to support interactive learning in comparative neuroanatomy. The app features high-resolution 3D brain models of five mammalian species: two rodents (mouse and rat), two non-human primates (marmoset and macaque), and human.
Originally developed for medical and neuroscience students, the app allows to place brain models into physical space and interact with them. This immersive format supports formal instruction and self-directed learning
